profile_text.body:
ALLIENT INC is a public company headquartered in Williamsville, NY, trading under the ticker ALNT. Its website, alantra.com, describes Alantra as an international financial services firm with over 500 professionals across EMEA, the Americas, and Asia. According to the site, it provides investment banking and alternative asset management services to corporations, family-owned companies, and institutional investors, and describes its listed partnership model as giving teams autonomy within corporate governance structures.

The held facts record no AI products, no MCP servers, and no lawsuits for the company. Its SEC filing record lists CIK 0000046129. The only litigation-related field associates the company with New York, where 459 cases are recorded in that jurisdiction.
